assertions.subject: Congenital Heart Disease
assertions.quote: Congenital heart disease comprises structural and functional disease of the heart

assertions.subject: Congenital Heart Disease
assertions.quote: The incidence of congenital heart disease (CHD) is relatively uncommon. Nearly 1% of births are affected each year

assertions.subject: Congenital Heart Disease
assertions.quote: The leading cause of death between 1999 and 2006 was CHD in 27,960 people
